basis: pre-registered BEFORE any LIP A/B/A data; measured run spread from chief_executor n=1024 x3 (15.73/15.42/15.55)
implication_single_prompt: 3 runs/arm resolves only ~>=0.21 tps; the DB-ON LIP upper bound (+0.17) is BELOW the resolution floor — WASH is not just expected, it is the statistically forced outcome of the 3-run protocol; a null result cannot be read as 'effect absent', only 'effect below floor'.

multi_prompt_bench_prediction.design: 13-prompt concatenated decode, n>=1024 each, retained cache (steady-state regime where LIP's sim gain lives)
multi_prompt_bench_prediction.note: even the multi-prompt steady-state gain is at the ~7-8 runs/arm resolution floor; recommend 8 runs/arm or a higher-signal readout (miss counters from T2's patch) instead of more tok/s runs

recommendation: the decisive LIP readout is the COUNTER log (per-request hits/misses from T2's patch in the same restart), not tps: sim predicts -1.29 miss/tok suffix delta which the counter resolves directly; tps A/B/A stays as the Chief-mandated coarse check
